name: Swapnajita Sankhua / ସ୍ଵପ୍ନାଜିତା ଶଙ୍ଖୁଆ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Swapnajita Sankhua is an Odia poet whose work appears in the anthology In Our Own Voice: Poems by Odia Women Poets, published by Black Eagle Books in 2023. Translated by J. P. Das and edited by Vinita Gupta Chaturvedi, the volume places her among several generations of women writing in Odia.

Her Kabita Live poem “ନିଜସହ” imagines renewal through a house, flowering plants and familiar domestic pleasures. The scent of pitha, a lamp clearing darkness and the pursuit of butterflies turn an inward encounter into something tangible. The poem’s question about who restores this brightness draws the reader back towards the self.
